fieldNotes.location: Confirmed: 2810 Kennedy Dr, Beloit WI 53511. Web research corroborates a large Frito-Lay manufacturing plant (140M+ lbs of snacks/yr, ~500 jobs, LEED-EB Gold, zero-landfill). Satellite shows a large dark-roof manufacturing building with rooftop process equipment and silos, dock banks, a large trailer drop yard, and a rail siding. Roster point landed on Kennedy Dr; center re-locked on the main plant building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant is chain-link fenced (visible in 2024 Street View along the Kennedy Dr frontage). Truck operations are accessed through a controlled fenced opening off the internal road; classified as a truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear guard booth resolved at the truck entrance from satellite or Street View — entrance appears to be a gated opening without a dedicated multi-window booth, so classified remoteGs (kiosk/badge check-in). Medium confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the north building face and along the west side with many trailers backed in; aggregate clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard SE of the plant with 100+ trailers in marked rows, plus overflow trailers on a grass apron near the rail. 50+ band; dedicated dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock clusters on physically separate building faces (north and west) indicate separated shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail tracks and a siding run alongside the SE building face near the silo/process area, consistent with rail delivery of raw materials. Marked true; flagged as the spur/siding-vs-mainline distinction is not fully certain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron and ample yard width at the truck entrance leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Beloit is a small Wisconsin city; the plant sits in an edge-of-town industrial/agricultural setting with farm fields bordering the north and south. Classified Rural per the small-town tiebreaker.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing plant plus an attached/adjacent warehouse section and a small office structure; ~3 distinct buildings on one contiguous campus (not a multi-cluster campus, so multipleFacilities false).
